parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/AudioPlayerAnalyticsTests.swift`. The near-duplicate signal (Jaccard 0.7) between `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesPauseEvent` (line 293) and `AudioEnginePlayerAnalyticsTests.capturesStopEvent` (line 310) reflects the natural structural similarity of distinct event-capture test cases — each must exercise a different event type (pause vs. stop) and is intentionally parallel in shape. Merging or abstracting these test methods would obscure which specific event is under test and reduce the diagnostic clarity of individual test failures. Per the restraint rules, any cluster where all participating records are test fixtures warrants no-action.
